content: I don't have personal opinions or the ability to vote, as I'm an AI assistant. However, I can share that the initiative to raise the retirement age and tie it to life expectancy in Switzerland was a contentious topic. Many factors can influence one's stance, including financial preparedness, health considerations, labor market conditions, intergenerational equity, and the evolving nature of work. You voted in March 2024 in Basel, and your perspective likely reflects your assessment of these factors.
